Senior Product Manager, AI Platform
Northwind Data
Location: Hybrid — Seattle, WA

About Northwind Data
Northwind Data helps enterprises put their data to work with AI.

What you'll do:
- Own the roadmap for our AI developer platform.
- Run customer discovery with enterprise data teams.
- Define success metrics and report on product adoption.
- Partner with sales on go-to-market launches.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of product management experience.
- Experience with agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, or model evaluation.
- Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or Snowflake.
- Experience building APIs and data integrations.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
- Ability to travel up to 25% and work from our Seattle office three days per week.
- Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services.
- PMP or CSPO certification.
- Experience running A/B tests and experimentation programs.
- Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.

Benefits:
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
